# Siterui SFX

> > Siterui SFX is a China-based manufacturer of professional stage special effects equipment including fog machines, haze machines, CO₂ jets, spark fountains, flame machines, and confetti systems with DMX512 control.

With over 15 years of experience, Siterui SFX specializes in theatrical and event production equipment featuring DMX control, wireless remote operation, and RGB LED integration. The company offers comprehensive solutions from water-based and oil-based haze generators to CO₂ jet systems and pyrotechnic-style spark effects for concerts, theaters, and live events.

## Key Topics

- DMX512 Control
- CO₂ Jet Systems
- Haze Machines (Water-based & Oil-based)
- Fog Machines
- Spark Machines & Fountains
- RGB LED Integration
- Wireless Remote Control
- Stage Special Effects
- Theatrical Effects
- Event Production Equipment
- Snow Machines
- Flame Machines
- Confetti & Ribbon Systems
- Professional SFX Equipment
